description: Defines a React component 'TodoItem' for a Todo MVC application, handling editing, toggling, and deleting todo items.

classes.name: TodoItem
classes.description: A React component representing a single todo item with editing and toggle capabilities.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles saving or deleting the todo item based on input value.

methods.name: handleEdit
methods.description: Initiates editing mode for the todo item.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key events for canceling or submitting edits.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Updates component state with current input value.

methods.name: shouldComponentUpdate
methods.description: Optimizes rendering by comparing current and next props/state.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Focuses input field when editing starts.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the todo item as a list element with checkbox, label, and edit input.
